title_en: The Legend of Zelda Switch 2 Special Edition Console and Pro Controller Confirmed
summary_en: Nintendo has now officially unveiled its The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Switch 2 console and Pro Controller, after product photos previously appeared online.
body_en:
Nintendo has now officially unveiled its The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Switch 2 console and Pro Controller, after product photos previously appeared online.
Today's Zelda-focused Nintendo Direct broadcast therefore gave us our first official look at the upcoming special edition console and controller, confirming that previous leak as legitimate. We also gained a release date: October 29.
As expected, Nintendo's Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 features a golden Triforce design printed on one side of its dock, while the main Switch 2 console unit sports black/teal Joy-Con controllers, each also adorned with Triforce patterns.
The matching Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller: The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition mirrors the black/teal coloring for its base, with a golden central Triforce design and gold shoulder buttons and triggers. Both items also sport the cute Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary logo, which features a small NES-era Link icon.
We'll update here when we know pricing details.
For everything else shown today, including news on the upcoming live-action Legend of Zelda movie, catch up on everything shown during the Legend of Zelda Nintendo Direct right here.
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social
